logline: 빈손으로 돌아오던 가난한 구두장이가 길가에서 벌거벗은 사람을 보고, 외투를 벗어 덮어 준다.
destination: 구두장이의 집 문턱 — 낯선 이가 세 번째로 웃게 되는 자리
protagonist: 외투 한 벌을 나눠 입는 가난한 시골 구두장이
setting: 19세기 러시아의 눈 덮인 시골 마을과 낮은 흙집 작업방
anchor: a stooped bearded cobbler in a patched sheepskin coat and felt boots
palette: snow blue-white, ember orange from a small stove, weathered timber brown

beats.visual: a stooped cobbler walking an empty snow road at dusk, low cottages far behind him
beats.motion: snow crunches under his boots, breath clouds, wind lifts loose snow

beats.beat: 교회 담 뒤에서 벌거벗은 남자를 발견한다.
beats.visual: a bare-shouldered figure huddled against a stone chapel wall in snow, cobbler halted before him
beats.motion: the huddled figure shivers, the cobbler stops mid-step, snow drifts past

beats.beat: 그는 제 외투를 벗어 그에게 덮어 준다.
beats.visual: a cobbler draping a heavy sheepskin coat over a seated stranger's shoulders in deep snow
beats.motion: the coat settles over the shoulders, snow slides off it, both breaths steam

beats.visual: a woman standing in a lit cottage doorway with arms folded, two men waiting in the snow outside
beats.motion: lamplight spills past her, her arm gestures sharply, snow blows across the sill

beats.visual: a quiet stranger seated by a small iron stove, faint smile forming, firelight on his face
beats.motion: firelight jumps across his face, his mouth curves, steam rises from a cup

beats.beat: 그는 하루 만에 구두 짓는 법을 익힌다.
beats.visual: a stranger stitching a boot at a low workbench with practiced hands, cobbler watching astonished
beats.motion: the awl pushes through leather, thread pulls tight, the cobbler leans closer

beats.beat: 그가 세 번째로 웃을 때 무엇을 알게 될까?
beats.visual: a stranger looking up from a workbench toward a woman holding two small children in a doorway
beats.motion: his head lifts, the children shift in her arms, lamplight steadies

beats.beat: 눈 덮인 마을에 창불 하나가 켜져 있다.
beats.visual: one lit cottage window in a snowbound village at night, snow deep on the low roofs
beats.motion: snow falls steadily, the window glow warms, smoke rises from the chimney

withheld: 낯선 이의 정체와 그가 배워야 했던 세 가지 진리
